name: Luca
canonical_description: A cheerful 4–5-year-old boy with soft golden-blond curly hair, bright blue eyes, fair skin, rosy cheeks, a round childlike face, and a warm expressive smile. He always wears a light blue T-shirt, beige shorts, and white sneakers. High-quality stylized 3D preschool animation with soft rounded features and warm cinematic lighting.
behavior_rules: Luca behaves like a friendly preschool child.
Luca reacts with curiosity and positive emotions.
negative_rules: Never portray Luca as an adult.
